channel.title: Daily Brief — Afternoon Edition
channel.description: A short daily news brief covering technology and AI, Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made for your afternoon drive.
channel.itunes:author: Daily Brief — Afternoon Edition

item.title: Daily Brief — Afternoon Edition — Tuesday, 15 September 2026
item.description: Today: Microsoft publishes a new AI Code of Conduct as tech-industry layoffs pass 210,000 for the year; Canberra presses ahead with a private health rebate cut for over-65s and Pauline Hanson offers a qualified apology; Queensland searches for a missing Biloela girl while the town's hospital regains birthing services; and the Gold Coast's Marine Quarter breaks ground as Suns forward Ben King eyes free agency. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (오늘의 브리핑 영어 방송 후 한국어 전체 브리핑이 이어집니다).

item.title: Daily Brief — Afternoon Edition — Monday, 14 September 2026
item.description: Today: Anthropic forecasts a profitable quarter as Fable 5.1 tops a new Real-SWE benchmark; two AI safety researchers depart Anthropic and Google DeepMind for METR; Australia's only nuclear reactor marks 20 years; Brisbane's parking-fine haul nears $35 million; and Gold Coast's Spit gets its first residential development plan. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (오늘의 브리핑 영어 방송 후 한국어 전체 브리핑이 이어집니다).

item.title: Daily Brief — Afternoon Edition — Sunday, 13 September 2026
item.description: Today: OpenAI launches its GPT-Live voice model and a new cross-industry AI-agent trust framework debuts; Australia's Parliament tackles superannuation and NDIS reform; Queensland investigates coalmine contraband and a new bee mite detection; and a 1995 Gold Coast cold case reopens. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (오늘의 브리핑 영어 방송 후 한국어 전체 브리핑이 이어집니다).
